👶 The parents left for a trip. You're watching the babies for 7 days.
🌙 Something is watching YOU.

Keep the babies alive, and whatever you do… don't open the door.

📜 Every threat has a rule. Break it and you're FIRED.
📅 New threats every night. Can you make it to Day 7?
👥 Solo or with friends.

👍 Like + ⭐ Favorite for new threats!
